Resolves #19392

🌿 A Skills release can no longer sit three days in this repository's Dependabot queue before anyone is asked to review it.

This is a leaf of neomjs/neo-agent-skills#144. Dependabot holds every version update for three days when no cooldown is configured (its default since 2026-07-14), and this repository configured none, so each `neo-agent-skills` release sat out three daily runs. The npm entry now exempts only that package. Every other package keeps the three days, made explicit, and security updates were never held. The schedule, groups, `exclude-patterns` and the `github-actions` entry are unchanged.

Evidence: L1 (config diff and a parse of the entry) → L1 required (AC-1). AC-2 is a delivery receipt on a real later release, owned by neomjs/neo-agent-skills#144.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| AC-1 | One block added to the npm entry. Parsed: `cooldown` = `{"default-days":3,"exclude":["neo-agent-skills"]}`, two update entries, everything else unchanged in the diff. |
| AC-2 | Post-merge (below). |

## Deltas from ticket

None.

## Test Evidence

YAML parse of `.github/dependabot.yml` at this head (js-yaml): the npm entry carries the cooldown and both ecosystems remain. GitHub's options reference documents the keys: "If not specified, Dependabot applies a default cooldown of 3 days", and `exclude` lists dependencies excluded from cooldown.

## Post-Merge Validation

- [ ] The next `neo-agent-skills` release younger than three days is proposed here as a standalone new or updated PR on the next scheduled run. The job line and the PR go on neomjs/neo-agent-skills#144 AC-2.
